title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there.

items.headline_md: US disables an Iran-blockade runner in the **Gulf of Oman**, launches **Task Force Iron Gate**
items.summary_md: CENTCOM says a US aircraft disabled the M/V Huda after it tried to breach the blockade, and a new ~20-person task force will target Iran's land and Caspian supply routes.

items.headline_md: **Herzog** taps **Gadi Eisenkot** to form Israel's next government
items.summary_md: Neither Netanyahu's bloc nor his rival's won a majority; Eisenkot gets 28 days, plus a possible 14-day extension.

items.headline_md: Gunman kills **six** in Kraków's main square
items.summary_md: Three more bodies were found at the attacker's home, and Poland's interior minister says far-right ideology may have influenced him.

items.headline_md: Houthi TV says at least **27** killed in strikes near **Sanaa**
items.summary_md: Houthi-run al-Masirah blamed Saudi warplanes; the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi cruise missile, and the claims weren't independently verified.

items.headline_md: **M5.7** quake hits central Japan, **20+** injured
items.summary_md: The 1:04 a.m. local quake centered in western Shizuoka registered upper 5 in Aichi; no tsunami warning.

items.headline_md: Heavy rain floods ~**70,000** tents in Gaza
items.summary_md: Gaza's media office says shelters washed away in 12 hours, with aid shortages hampering the response.

items.headline_md: Update: ousted Paraguay president **Santiago Peña** formally charged
items.summary_md: Prosecutors charged him with breach of trust tied to the Ueno Bank collapse.

items.headline_md: **Berkshire Hathaway** Q3 operating earnings **$12.71B**; buybacks more than double to **$9.6B**
items.summary_md: Berkshire shares rose 5%+ this week while the S&P fell almost 2.7%, as money rotated out of AI-heavy tech.

items.headline_md: AP: midterm results reshuffled Wall Street winners and losers
items.summary_md: AI, defense and oil stocks fell on expectations of tighter data-center rules and an end to the Iran war, while hospitals and tariff-hit liquor makers rose.

items.headline_md: NASA's **$10B** CLPS 2 lunar contract picks vendors including **ispace U.S.** and **Firefly**
items.summary_md: The 10-year master contract lets selected companies bid on Moon delivery missions.

items.headline_md: **Poppy Playtime Chapter 5** lands on Android and iOS
items.summary_md: The horror series' latest chapter is out on mobile.

items.headline_md: **Call of Duty: Mobile** 7th anniversary Season 10 brings **Verdansk** and **Gulag** on Nov 11
items.summary_md: It's a big Battle Royale overhaul for the anniversary season.

items.headline_md: Nexon's **TalesWeaver** is getting a mobile MMORPG
items.summary_md: A focus-group test is set for December in Korea, with sign-ups through Nov 15.

items.headline_md: Sony delays **PlayStation Pulse Elevate** speakers indefinitely
items.summary_md: The delay came less than a week before launch; the same roundup notes Warzone is now out on Switch 2.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no new public repo or release from the r/decomps developer found today. GitHub search turned up only older Wii U recomp projects (CafeRecomp, nWiiURecomp). r/decomps itself couldn't be read this run (the RSS fetch timed out).

items.headline_md: **Hookshot**: NotRexed's native PC recomp of the **Switch 2** *Ocarina of Time* remake
items.summary_md: It statically recompiles the game's Arm code into a Windows build you make from your own copy, adding frame gen, upscaling and ultrawide; the dev reports ~50 fps without frame gen on a Ryzen 7600X + RTX 4060 Ti, and three new builds shipped overnight (new installer, no Visual Studio needed, AMD black-screen fix).

items.headline_md: **Nxnative** adds Switch 2 support on Mac, running *Ocarina of Time* smoothly
items.summary_md: It runs the game's ARM64 code directly on Apple chips and translates graphics to Metal, and clips show 60 fps in the Great Deku Tree.

items.headline_md: Recomp week: **271** releases, including **Virtua Fighter Recomp v1.6.0**, **TotK Recomp v0.3.13** and **NSMB Wii Multiplayer v0.5.0**
items.summary_md: Also new are SMM2 Recomp v0.7.10, Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction Recompiled v1.2.0, ps2-native-recomp v0.0.2 and a fresh Xenia Canary build.

items.headline_md: Update: **Godzilla Minus Zero** opens to ~**$32M** (Nov 6–8 est.), a record
items.summary_md: That's the biggest domestic opening ever for a live-action foreign-language film, with an A CinemaScore and 74% of the gross from IMAX and premium screens.

items.headline_md: **The Cat in the Hat** takes No. 2 with ~**$20M**
items.summary_md: WB's animated film got an A CinemaScore but 48% from critics on Rotten Tomatoes.

items.headline_md: **Drummer Boy** ~**$8.8M** at No. 3; **You Can See Everything** ~**$7.8M**, total **$78.7M**
items.summary_md: A24's doc is set to pass March of the Penguins ($77.4M), and some now see a $100M shot.

items.headline_md: **Ramayana: Rise of a Legend** ~**$7.3M** three-day (**$10.8M** total); **Wild Horse Nine** ~**$4.5M**
items.summary_md: Ramayana is the widest North American release for an Indian film; Wild Horse Nine is 89% on RT.

items.headline_md: Weekend total ~**$114M**, the best first November weekend since Covid
items.summary_md: It's up 40% from the same weekend last year.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** banks **$11B** first tranche at a **$1.25T** valuation
items.summary_md: The round could reach $20B; OpenAI had sought $30B at $1.4T before the AI selloff, and Anthropic is reportedly moving toward an IPO.

items.headline_md: OpenAI releases **BioBasicsBench** for wet-lab analysis
items.summary_md: GPT-6 Astra scored 66.7% vs 43.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol on 100 lab tasks, and OpenAI says models still stumble on controls and imaging.

items.headline_md: **Cohere** valued at **US$25.5B** as Canada and Nvidia back its Series E
items.summary_md: Canada committed up to CAD1.6B in equity in a round targeting up to CAD7B.

items.headline_md: **Meta** and China's **Fourier** built a humanoid robot prototype, "Max"
items.summary_md: The Information reports the 106-lb robot took three months, and a second version is underway.

items.headline_md: Apple ships five products Nov 6, including its first **OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros**
items.summary_md: Also out: an OLED iPad mini (A20 Pro), an M6 iMac and an M6 14-inch MacBook Pro, with HomeView and a new Apple TV 4K coming Nov 13.

items.headline_md: **iOS 27.3** beta adds Safari vertical tabs, Adaptive Dark Mode and Siri AI tweaks
items.summary_md: The revamped Health app is back and due before year-end.

items.headline_md: WSJ: the AI-driven memory shortage gives flash suppliers leverage over Apple
items.summary_md: Shortages and high prices are expected to persist through 2030.

items.headline_md: Xbox tests using your phone as a controller on smart TVs
items.summary_md: It's part of a push to make cloud gaming easier to reach.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: US markets are closed for the weekend; there are no fresh oil or gold quotes since Friday's settle (covered yesterday).

items.headline_md: Week: all three US indexes posted weekly losses; S&P **−~2.7%**
items.summary_md: Friday close (4 PM ET / 2 PM AZ): the Philadelphia chip index rose 4.2% and Nvidia gained nearly 3% after its worst day since Jan 2025.
Quoted Sun Nov 8; the page doesn't show an exact time.

items.headline_md: "Houston, we have a wardrobe problem": NASA's Moon spacesuits may not be ready for 2028
items.summary_md: This Washington Post deep dive into Axiom's troubled suit program shows how one piece of hardware could slip the Artemis landing.
